events.text:
I found 85 likely duplicate pairs, but I haven't merged anything. Merges can't be undone, and "clean them up" isn't specific enough for me to run 85 of them.

**Decision needed:** may I merge the 73 pairs that match on name, address and tax ID?

- **73 pairs (name, address and tax ID match):** These are very likely true duplicates. One example is C-1001/C-1440 "Pellham Industrial". I recommend merging them. For each pair I would keep the first-listed ID and move all orders and invoices onto it. Tell me if you want a different survivor rule, such as keeping the older record.
- **12 pairs (name and address match, tax IDs differ):** These may be separate legal entities. One example is C-2210/C-2875 "Ridgeview Holdings", with tax IDs 41-0091822 and 41-0091950. I recommend not merging them until someone on your side has reviewed them.

I haven't reviewed the full list, `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`. Once you confirm, I'll merge the 73 pairs and report the results. I'll also leave the 12 for review.
Hold off for now. I want to look at the list myself first.

Understood. I'm holding off and have made no merges. All 85 pairs are unchanged. The full list is in `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`. When you've reviewed it, tell me which pairs to merge and which record to keep in each.
